identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Husqvarna US and UK product or support pages. 450X EPOS, 440 iQ, 415X and 310 Mark II are four separate models with their own pages. No new model was created and no Husqvarna company focus review exists. The 450X EPOS and 415X support pages publish no price, so the catalog prices are cleared; the 440 iQ page publishes 4,299.99 USD and the 310 Mark II page a 1,014.30 GBP campaign price. Weight, dimensions, cutting width, slope limits and IP ratings are documented for all four. Battery capacity, run time and charging time are documented where the pages publish them; the 450X EPOS and 415X publish run time but no battery capacity or charging time. No reviewed page publishes payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity. The 440 iQ page carries a manufacturer ranking claim that is not treated as independent evidence.

fields.description: The Husqvarna Automower 450X EPOS is a robotic lawn mower for lawns up to 2.5 acres (plus or minus 20%) with a 9.45 in cutting width, three pivoting razor blades, dual cutting direction and a skid plate. It handles slopes up to 15% at the boundary and 45% inside the installation, runs up to 24 hours of active time and supports virtual transport paths. Control is through a professional user interface and app with a 2.8 in monochrome display, smart home integration and FOTA updates. The robot weighs 31.7 lbs, measures 28.3 x 22 x 12.6 in, is rated IPX4, emits 65 dB(A) and mows for about 210 minutes per charge. GPS theft tracking, PIN code, lift and tilt sensors are included. The page publishes no price, battery capacity, charging time, payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity; the catalog 3,300 USD price is cleared.

fields.description: The Husqvarna Automower 440 iQ is a wire-free robotic lawn mower for lawns up to 2 acres (plus or minus 20%) with EPOS satellite positioning, virtual boundaries and a reference station. It handles slopes up to 15% at the boundary and 45% inside the installation, runs up to 24 hours of active time and cuts at 9.4 in width with three pivoting razor blades and an electric cutting-height range of 1 to 4 in. A 7.5 Ah lithium-ion battery supports about 138 minutes of mowing per charge and recharges in 54 minutes at 7 A. The robot weighs 39 lbs, measures 29.6 x 21.4 x 11.1 in, is rated IPX5, emits 62 dB(A) and connects over cellular, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth with the Automower Connect app, radar object detection, GPS tracking, GeoFence, PIN code, alarm, lift and tilt sensors. The purchase includes a 4-year warranty and one year of free blades. The page publishes no payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity.
